name: growi-mcp-server
description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) HTTP server with Bearer authentication that connects AI models to GROWI wiki content.
author: nop <noplab90@gmail.com>

scripts.build: pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && pnpm ncc build ./.build/index.js --license ./LICENSE
scripts.start: pnpm build && cross-env NODE_ENV=production node dist/index.js
scripts.dev: nodemon --watch src --ext ts,json --exec "cross-env NODE_ENV=development pnpm tsx src/index.ts"
